itens.trecho: Squid Game 3 Comecei a ver a terceira temporada com bastante entusiasmo. Os dois primeiros episódios deixaram-me agarrado, especialmente aquele jogo inicial, que para mim se tornou num dos melhores jogos de toda a saga Squid Game. Mas infelizmente, foi só fogo de vista.

Whilst not an entirely original idea, "Squid Game" is done with enough inspiration, to warrant at least, a look. That said, it took me quite some time to tune in. The idea didn't immediately appeal to me, as it did a lot of other viewers. I found the first season, creative, colourful and more than little disturbing.

Squid Game (Season 1) is a gripping South Korean thriller that blends intense social commentary with pulse-pounding drama. The story follows 456 desperate contestants competing in deadly children’s games for a massive cash prize, exposing the brutal extremes of capitalism and human desperation.
